name: Sweden (Royal Standard)
description: A triple-tailed (tretungad) Swedish flag — blue with a yellow Nordic cross — charged at the centre of the cross with a white panel bearing the greater national arms of Sweden.
history: The personal flag of the Swedish monarch, flown at the royal palaces and on vessels carrying the King. It is the three-tailed state flag with the greater coat of arms (with the Serafimer order chain) on a white panel at the cross centre.

features.role: greater royal arms of Sweden on a white panel
